events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe 32nd Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your top track from the album that launched a thousand anthems?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, running until August 18th.

angles.name: Woodstock 1969
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. Which iconic artist's performance do you wish you'd witnessed live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll lives on. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, their last recorded work together.

angles.name: Abbey Road Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. That album cover is legendary, but what's the track you always go back to?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude have shaped rock for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune featuring that unmistakable voice?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975, and in the US on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' – a song that still resonates globally. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: First iPod
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that revolutionised portable music. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond film ever made?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The brilliant comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your absolute favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: The iconic 'White Album' by The Beatles dropped on this day in '68. So much diversity on one record! Which track is your unexpected favourite?
